edges.reason: transfer uses msg.sender as the debited source account in balances[msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using caller identity.
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender] using caller identity.
approveAndCall sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] from caller identity.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before staging a new owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to take ownership.
FixedSupplyToken constructor mints _totalSupply to owner derived from msg.sender.
Owned constructor sets owner = msg.sender, the root of all privilege.
Caller-supplied _newOwner is written to newOwner without validation.
transferOwnership writes the pending owner pointer.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner and resets it to address(0).
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner, transferring privilege.
approveAndCall invokes the untrusted spender's receiveApproval, which can re-enter the token.
transferAnyERC20Token makes an external call to an arbitrary token contract chosen by the owner input.
Recovered tokens are transferred to the owner address.
transfer mutates the balances mapping for both sender and recipient.
approve overwrites the allowed mapping entry.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping of from and to.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping of from and msg.sender.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
totalSupply performs _totalSupply.sub(balances[address(0)]) which reverts on underflow.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] as the burned supply.
Constructor computes 300000000 * 10**uint(decimals) for the fixed supply.
Constructor mints the whole supply into balances[owner].
Constructor assigns the token symbol.
Constructor assigns the token name.
Constructor assigns the decimals value.
transfer credits the caller-supplied 'to' address.
transfer amount 'tokens' flows into SafeMath.sub and SafeMath.add.
approve stores the spender key in the allowed mapping.
approve stores the tokens value as the allowance amount.
transferFrom trusts the 'from' argument, debiting balances[from] using caller allowance.
transferFrom credits the caller-supplied 'to' address.
transferFrom amount flows into two SafeMath.sub and one SafeMath.add.
allowance indexes the allowed mapping by tokenOwner.
allowance indexes the allowed mapping by spender.
approveAndCall uses spender both as allowance key and external call target.
approveAndCall amount is granted and forwarded to the callback.
approveAndCall forwards attacker-influenced bytes data into receiveApproval.
Owner-supplied tokenAddress becomes the target of the external ERC20 call.
tokens parameter is passed into the external ERC20 transfer call.
balanceOf indexes balances by the tokenOwner parameter.
Named return local balance receives balances[tokenOwner].
Named return local remaining receives allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
